key_teaching_points.explanation: You will need — A coloured paper (30 cm long and 20 cm wide) and eight paper strips of two different colours (3 cm wide and longer than 20 cm). (a) Take a coloured paper 30 cm long and 20 cm wide. (b) Fold the coloured paper in half along the longer side. (c) Draw vertical lines at equal distances from the closed end and cut slits leaving a gap of 3 cm at the top. (d) Carefully unfold the paper.

key_teaching_points.explanation: There will be no cuts in the paper at the top and the bottom. (e) Now cut 8 paper strips of 3 cm width in 2 colours and of length slightly longer than 20 cm. (f) Take one colour strip and weave it across the slits going 1 under and 1 over, and again 1 under and 1 over.
